_comment: Verified against Tesla FY2022 10-K raw extraction CSV. Keys must match raw PDF labels (lowercased, with spaces).

_notes.total_revenue: Tesla uses 'Total revenues' (plural, no 'net') as the top-line label.
_notes.operating_income: Tesla calls this 'Income from operations', not 'Operating income'.
_notes.selling_general_administrative: Tesla uses 'Selling, general and administrative' — note the comma after 'Selling'.
_notes.total_assets: Tesla DOES have a 'Total assets' row on the balance sheet (page 48).
_notes.llm_failure: LLM auto-mapper used underscore keys instead of space-separated raw labels. This file is manually corrected.
